name: sri-sai-shanmukha-auto-centre
description: Business website, parts catalogue, blog and enquiry dashboard for Sri Sai Shanmukha Auto Centre

scripts.cloudflare:db:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply sssa-shop-data --local
scripts.cloudflare:db:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply sssa-shop-data --remote
scripts.cloudflare:pages:dev: npm run cloudflare:pages:build && cd pages-config && npx wrangler pages dev ../dist-pages
scripts.cloudflare:pages:deploy: npm run cloudflare:pages:build && cd pages-config && npx wrangler pages deploy ../dist-pages --project-name sri-sai-shanmukha-auto-centre --branch main
